parent_programmes.relationship: Phase-V target-generalization audit; prior axis-release results remain frozen

scientific_question: Does the separation between mechanism identifiability, exact counterfactual-map identifiability and decision identifiability persist when the counterfactual is a prospectively frozen ecological transformation rather than deletion of one BAM axis?

fixed_systems.current_evidence: E1 complete perfect current distribution G

universes.W1: preregistered 2,592-world ecological expansion lattice from Phase IV, filtered to exact same current G for each fiber

climate_shift.operator: recompute A under node environments shifted by temperature +0.08 and moisture -0.04; keep each world's niche center/radius, B and M unchanged
climate_shift.note: synthetic climate perturbation, not calibrated to a real emissions scenario

biotic_stress.operator: apply one additional 4-neighbour erosion to the world's current partner range and one additional 4-neighbour dilation to its current antagonist range; recompute B under the same interaction-mode bits; keep A and M unchanged
biotic_stress.binary_target: range_loss = G_cf is a strict subset of G_current
biotic_stress.note: synthetic associate-range stress, not a calibrated demographic interaction model

barrier_restoration.operator: recompute M with the world's same dispersal radius and movement horizon but barrier_permeable forced true; keep A and B unchanged
barrier_restoration.binary_target: range_gain = G_cf contains at least one node outside G_current

targets.parameter_world: exact declared parameter-world identity (world ID in W0; full ecological parameter coordinates in W1)
targets.current_bam_state: current A/B/M plus movement-arrival tau equivalence
targets.exact_counterfactual: exact finite-node G_cf for each frozen transformation

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: For every transformation and universe level, binary-decision identification count is at least exact-counterfactual-map identification count, which is at least exact parameter-world identification count.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: Any violation is a target-definition or implementation failure and stops interpretation.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: At least one truth that is identified at the current BAM-state level nevertheless has an unresolved exact or binary structured-counterfactual target because current-state-equivalent parameter worlds respond differently after transformation.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if no current-BAM-state-identified fiber is reopened by any frozen structured transformation.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: For each of the three structured transformations in W0, at least one parameter-world-nonidentified truth nevertheless has an identified binary decision.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED separately for any transformation without such a case.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: For at least one transformation, at least one binary decision identified in W0 becomes unresolved in W1.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if no structured transformation loses any W0 binary certificate under W1.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: For every transformation, at least one parameter-world-nonidentified binary decision remains identified after expansion from W0 to W1.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED separately for any transformation without such a case.

primary_outputs: mechanism/exact-map/binary-decision identification counts in W0 and W1
W0 decision certificates lost under W1
W0 decision certificates retained under W1
same-G fiber target-class distributions for each transformation
examples of mechanism-unresolved but decision-identified fibers and fibers whose decision changes under W1
stop_rules: Do not change the climate deltas after scoring.
Do not add or remove B stress operations after scoring.
Do not change barrier restoration from forced permeability after scoring.
Do not add additional counterfactuals to rescue a refuted hypothesis.
Do not call these three transformations calibrated real-species scenarios.
Do not alter the frozen Phase-I through Phase-IV results or manuscripts.

novelty_boundary.candidate_contribution: Within an occurrence-conditioned BAM inverse survivor fiber, test target-specific identifiability under explicit ecological transformations and track whether the target certificate survives a preregistered expansion of the admissible BAM world family.

protocol_amendment.reason: Pre-implementation design audit: structured transformations can reactivate parameter aliases that share the same current A/B/M/tau state, so counterfactual targets are not guaranteed to be deterministic functions of current BAM-state equivalence.
protocol_amendment.correction: Use exact parameter-world identity as the finest target for the guaranteed target-coarsening hierarchy; retain current BAM-state identification as a separate diagnostic and preregister dormant-alias activation.
